itemized.notes: A wholly self-funded one-in-one-out filing: the single contribution is from the candidate himself (Christian Burridge, 'Attorney / Siegfried & Jensen') and the single expenditure is the same 783.60 paid to a direct-mail vendor. THE ONE UNRESOLVED CELL IS THE p3 DATE: it prints '12/', then a day field in which two digits are written on top of each other (readable as either 18 or 28 - there is a clear second stroke through the tens digit), then '/09'. Escalated to an 800 dpi cell crop and it still does not resolve, and no arithmetic constrains a date, so the ISO date is left BLANK with needs_review=1 rather than guessed; the month 12 and year 09 are legible but a partial date is not emitted. The p4 date is unambiguous at the same treatment. The Complete Mailing Address cell on p3 is NOT county-redacted - it holds the filer's own faint handwritten address, most of it illegible in this scan; per the privacy rule no street/PO detail was recorded, and no city or state was legible either, so donor_city/donor_state are blank. Summary Page arithmetic closes exactly: line 3 '0' + line 4 783.60 = line 5 783.60; 783.60 - 783.60 = line 7 '0'. Both zero cells are written as a bare closed loop '0' (a numeral, not a dash) and read as zero. The YEAR-END January-31 box is checked, matching the clerk listing label. Column B carries 783.60 on both lines, though line 1's Column B is written without a decimal point ('78360') - a filer formatting quirk on a cell outside this tranche's scope.
